buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Scope of Work. The AMC shall include prevention maintenance, breakdown maintenance, inspection, testing, servicing and repair of the CCTV surveillance sys. 2. Equipment Covered. The AMC shall cover CCTV cameras, NVR/ DVR, monitors switches, power supply un its, storages devices, connectors, cables and other associated CCTV/network equipment installed at site. 3. Preventive Maintenance. The service provider shall be carrying out preventive maintenance, inspection cleaning, and testing, direction of Cameras, pneumatic connection, electric power supply & earth connecti on and proper recording of HDD of the CCTV sys once every month to ensure satisfactory and trouble free functioning of the CCTV sys. 4. Response Time. The service provider shall attend breakdown complaint within 48 hrs of reporting and re store the sys to operational condition within 72 hrs. 5. Genuine Parts, Consumable & Replacement. The service provider shall use genuine OEM parts of the sa me make/brand as installed at site such as CP Plus. The service provider shall replace 30% of the total inst alled CCTV items with new items of the same make/brand during the AMC period at no additional cost. 6. Power Supply. The service provider shall inspect the power supply arrangement of CCTV equipments an d rectify fault affecting the operation of the system. 7 Testing after repair. After every repair/ replacement, the service provider shall test the equipment/ syste m and ensure satisfactory operation before handing it over to the user. 8 Non- Degradation of performance. Repair/ maintenance shall not result in any degradation of the existin g performance, image quality, recording capability or functionality of the CCTV system. 9. Obsolescence Management. In case any CCTV component becomes obsolete during the AMC period, a s uitable 'Form, Fit and Function' replacement shall be provided, wherever applicable 10. Service Reports. A service/ maintenance report shall be submitted after each preventive maintenance visit and breakdown repair, duly acknowledged by the authorised representative of the user 11. Security & Confidentiality. The service provider shall ensure confidentiality and security of CCTV footag e, recordings, passwords system configurations and other information accessed during maintenances. 12 Service Personnel. The service provider shall depute suitably qualified/ experienced technical personnel for repair and maintenance of the CCTV system. 13. Liquidated Damages. Delaying repair/ maint, installation, or service allows the user to hold payment an d deduct a penalty of 0.5% of contract value per week of delay, capped at maximum of 10% of the contrac t value. 14 Payment Payment will be release upon complete and satisfactory execution of services, subject to verification and final acceptance.

15. No Chinese make/product/ sub part. Confirmation on firm head that No Chinese make/product/sub part is being offered. 16. Burnt and damage eqpt. Burnt, physically damage/ damage due to external causes eqpt shall be fwd u nder AMC and shall be repaired at no addi cost. 17. Delivery and transportation. The service will be provided at the location of eqpt. Any charges occurred due to transportation of the eqpt for repair will be borne by seller only. 18 All the queries about the system should be dissolved during the pre bid meeting and bidder must be aw are about the complete sys, loc and functionality. 19. All bidders have sign and stamp on each page of scope of work, if not signing of the same will be reject ed in tech evaluation. . 2. OEM IMPORTED PRODUCTS: In case of imported products, OEM or Authorized Seller of OEM should have a registered office in India to provide after sales service support in India. The certificate to this effect should be submitted. 3. Service & Support Dedicated /toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support : BIDDER/OEM must have Dedicated/toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support. 4. Service & Support Escalation Matrix For Service Support : Bidder/OEM must provide Escalation Matrix of Telephone Numbers for Service Support. 5. Warranty Timely Servicing / rectification of defects during warranty period: After having been notified of the defects / service requirement during warranty period, Seller has to complete the required Service / Rectification within 3 days time limit. If the Seller fails to complete service / rectification with defined time limit, a penalty of 0.5% of Unit Price of the product shall be charged as penalty for each week of delay from the seller. Seller can deposit the penalty with the Buyer directly else the Buyer shall have a right to recover all such penalty amount from the Performance Security (PBG).Cumulative Penalty cannot exceed more than 10% of the total contract value after which the Buyer shall have the right to get the service / rectification done from alternate sources at the risk and cost of the Seller besides forfeiture of PBG. Seller shall be liable to re-imberse the cost of such service / rectification to the Buyer.
